normalization_plan.reason: The _protocol parameter only selects the protocol/pool token consumed by the single-protocol deposit core function
The _tokens array is only meaningful as the iteration input to depositToProtocol's transfers
The _dnAmounts array is only used as the transfer amounts inside depositToProtocol
nAmount is a scratch accumulator purely internal to the deposit computation
nBalanceBefore is simply the cached return value of distributeYieldInternal
nBalanceAfter is simply the cached return value of updateProtocolBalance
nDeposit is only used as the argument passed to PoolToken.mint
cap is only assigned from and validated against the userCap core function result
fee is a transient computation local to the withdraw function
